papers.hint: One row per student, the latest attempt. Earlier attempts stay readable from the paper.

contentEditor.assetUnbound: Asset not linked in this prototype
contentEditor.invalidContent: This content has an unsupported structure. The original is unchanged.
contentEditor.pasteBlocked: The complete paste could not be converted: it includes a file, unsupported formatting, or content over the limit. The current content is unchanged. Use Ctrl+Shift+V to deliberately paste plain text and reapply formatting.
contentEditor.editBlocked: This change contains an unsupported structure, a duplicate gap, or exceeds the content limit. Previous content is unchanged.
contentEditor.heading: Heading
contentEditor.spikeDescription: Synthetic examples. Changes stay in this session and are not saved to a server; reloading discards them.
contentEditor.sessionOnly: Kept in this prototype session only
contentEditor.previewHelp: The preview uses a renderer independent of the editor.
contentEditor.pasteDescription: Review the content below before inserting it at the selected position. Supported formatting is retained; fonts, sizes, colors and spacing follow the test layout.
contentEditor.pasteStale: The content changed during preview. Paste again at the intended position; your current edits are unchanged.

groups.independentHint: Questions in this group share their materials. Copies in the bank or another test are edited independently.
groups.instructionsHint: Instructions for the whole group, shown before its materials.
groups.removeMaterialBody: This material and its gap links will be removed. Questions and library files will be retained.
groups.removeQuestionBody: This question and its answers will be removed from this group. Independent copies and published tests will remain unchanged.
groups.removeBoundHint: This question is linked from shared material. Remove or change its material gap links before deleting the question.
groups.selectContent: Select a material or question to edit.
groups.assetHint: Choose a library file or upload a new one.
groups.assetLabelHint: Learners see this label; keep it short and descriptive.
groups.imageLimit: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 10 MB.
groups.uploadFailed: The file could not be uploaded. Please retry.
groups.linkHint: Select text to add or edit a link.
groups.linkHTTPS: Only HTTPS addresses are supported. Links do not open while editing.
groups.selectionChanged: The content changed. Close the dialog and select the insertion point again.
groups.sharedPolicyHint: The allowance is shared across this group and survives learner navigation and reloads.
groups.gapHint: Link every gap to a choice question or a specific answer blank. Each target can be linked once.
groups.chooseTarget: Choose a question or answer blank
groups.titleRequired: Enter a group name between 1 and 200 characters.
groups.limitExceeded: This group exceeds the content limits. Split it into smaller groups.
groups.invalidQuestion: Check the question content and answers.
groups.materialTitleRequired: Enter a material name between 1 and 200 characters.
groups.unboundGaps: Link every gap to an existing question or answer blank.
groups.duplicateTarget: A question or answer blank is linked more than once.
groups.choiceTargetRequired: A choice gap must link to a choice question.
groups.loadFailed: Could not load the question group. Please retry.
groups.recoveryTitle: Unsynced edits are available on this device
groups.recoveryBody: Drafts are kept for your account for up to 7 days. Restore to review and continue editing, or discard to use the server version.
groups.discardDraft: Discard draft and use server version
groups.localUnavailable: Unsynced · Local recovery is unavailable. Save to the server before closing.
groups.saveFailed: Could not save. Your edits remain on screen; please retry.
groups.localSaved: Unsynced · Draft saved on this device
groups.conflictBody: Your edits are preserved. Continue editing and save as a new bank group; the current server version will remain unchanged.
groups.archivedHint: This group is archived. Restore it from the list before editing.
groups.leaveBody: Save to the server before leaving, or keep a local draft to recover later.
groups.bankHint: Keep passages, recordings and their questions together. Each use in a test creates an independent copy.
groups.search: Search group titles or question text…
groups.archiveBody: Archive these groups from the active list. Test copies and published versions remain unchanged.
groups.restoreBody: Restore the selected groups to the active list.
groups.deleteBody: Permanently delete archived groups and their owned materials and questions. Independent test copies remain unchanged. This cannot be undone.
groups.legacyMaterial: This historical material uses Markdown. Edit the source and use Preview material to review it.

imports.historyHint: Each import keeps its original files, its processing progress and your review. You can come back at any time.
imports.emptyHint: Upload a Word or PDF exam to have its structure rebuilt, then review it before a draft is created.
imports.notFound: This import could not be found.
imports.newHint: Upload the Word or PDF exam and, if you have one, a separate answer key. You'll review the result before a draft test is created.

upload.examHint: The original exam as a Word or PDF document, with its questions and possibly its answers.
upload.answer_keyHint: Only needed when the key is in a separate file. Skip it if the exam already contains its answers.
upload.answer_keyChoose: Choose file for the answer key
upload.rejectType: {{name}} isn't a supported format. Choose a {{formats}} file.
upload.failed: Couldn't upload the file. Please try again.
upload.startFailed: Couldn't start processing. Please try again.
upload.examRequired: An exam file is needed before processing.
upload.limitsFailed: Couldn't load the file limits. The server still checks them on upload.
upload.limits: Accepts {{formats}} files up to {{size}} each. Files with a password or macros are refused, and so are scanned or photographed PDFs (with no selectable text).
upload.titleHint: Filled in from the exam filename; you can change it.
upload.titleLocked: The import was created with this title. You can rename it during review.
upload.recognitionNote: Sections, groups, questions and answers are recognised automatically. No answer is guessed: a missing key is flagged for you to enter.
upload.keepOpen: Keep this page open until the upload finishes.

processing.retryWaiting: Waiting to retry automatically. There's nothing you need to do.

runError.SOURCE_INVALID: The file is damaged or isn't a valid Word document. Open it in Word, save it as .docx and upload it again.
runError.SOURCE_UNSUPPORTED: The file is password-protected, has macros or holds unsupported content. Use an unlocked copy without macros.
runError.SOURCE_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large once unpacked. Split the exam or shrink its images, then upload it again.
runError.LEGACY_CONVERSION_UNAVAILABLE: Legacy .doc files can't be converted right now. Save the file as .docx and upload it again.
runError.CONVERSION_FAILED: This file's layout couldn't be read. Open it in Word, save it as .docx and upload it again.
runError.STORAGE_INTEGRITY_FAILED: The stored original can no longer be read. Upload the file again.
runError.STOPPED: Processing stopped and can't run again with the same file. Check the file and upload another copy.
runError.STORAGE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: Import storage is full. Try again once space is available, or contact your administrator.
runError.PIPELINE_RETIRED: The old processing version was retired. Try again to process with the current one.
runError.TEMPORARY: The processing service had a temporary problem. Your files are kept; try again in a few minutes.
runError.INTERNAL: Processing couldn't be completed. Your files are kept; try again.
runError.UNKNOWN: Processing stopped for an unexpected reason. Your files are kept; try again.
runError.PDF_NO_TEXT: This PDF has no selectable text; it is usually a scan or a photo. Use the Word file, or a PDF exported directly from Word.
runError.PDF_PROTECTED: This PDF has a password. Use a copy without one.
runError.PDF_INVALID: This PDF is damaged or cannot be read. Export the PDF again, or use the Word file.
runError.PDF_TOO_LARGE: This PDF is too long or too complex to read (60 pages at most). Split the exam and upload it again.

reprocess.failed: The latest reprocess didn't finish. The current review is unchanged.
reprocess.cancelled: The latest reprocess was stopped. The current review is unchanged.

imports.staleData: Couldn't refresh; showing the last known information.

detail.awaitingBody: This import is missing files or hasn't been started. Add what's missing, then start processing.
detail.processingBody: You can leave this page; processing continues and you can come back from the import history.
detail.cancelBody: Processing stops and the import is closed; it can't be continued. The original files are kept under the retention policy.
detail.reprocessBody: If you've edited the review, your version is kept and the new result is offered alongside it; if not, the new result replaces the current review.
detail.stopReprocessBody: The reprocess stops. Your current review and all your edits stay as they are, ready to continue.
detail.closeBody: The import is closed and can't be continued. The original files stay available under the retention policy.
detail.closeBodyReview: The import is closed and no draft test can be created from this review any more. The review and the original files stay viewable under the retention policy.
detail.closeFailed: Couldn't cancel the import. The current state has been reloaded.
detail.cancelFailed: Couldn't cancel. The current state has been reloaded.
detail.committingBody: This usually takes a few seconds. The page updates by itself.
detail.readyBody: The exam has been rebuilt from the document. Review what must be fixed or confirmed before creating the draft.
detail.committedBody: The draft test has been created and is in your tests. Open it in the builder to view and edit it.
detail.replaceHint: Choose another file to replace the one that failed; this import is then processed again with it.
detail.cancelledBody: The original files are kept under the retention policy.
detail.cancelledBodyReview: The review and the original files stay viewable under the retention policy.
detail.closedIdleBody: This import closed itself after {{days}} days without changes.
detail.closedIdleBodyPlain: This import closed itself after a long time without changes.
detail.cancelledBodyDays: The original files are kept for {{days}} days after closing, then removed.
detail.cancelledBodyReviewDays: The review and the original files stay viewable for {{days}} days after closing, then are removed.
detail.closeBodyDays: The import will be closed and cannot continue. The original files stay viewable for {{days}} more days, then are removed.
detail.closeBodyReviewDays: The import will be closed and you won't be able to create a draft test from this review. The review and the original files stay viewable for {{days}} more days, then are removed.
detail.cancelBodyDays: Processing will stop and the import will be closed; it cannot be continued. The original files are kept for {{days}} more days, then removed.

source.title: Source document
source.notExtracted: This document hasn't been extracted yet.

MISSING_ANSWER.title: The document has no answer for this question
MISSING_ANSWER.help: Mark or enter the correct answer, or exclude the question. Answers are never guessed.

CONFLICTING_ANSWER_KEYS.title: The sources give different answers
CONFLICTING_ANSWER_KEYS.help: Check each value in the document, then choose the right one or mark the answer yourself.

UNUSABLE_ANSWER_KEY.title: The answer in the document can't be used
UNUSABLE_ANSWER_KEY.help: The value in the document doesn't match any option. Mark or enter the answer yourself.

UNMATCHED_ANSWER_KEY.help: Check in the answer key which question these lines belong to. If they aren't needed, confirm to leave them out.

AMBIGUOUS_KEY_PAPER.title: The answer key holds several papers
AMBIGUOUS_KEY_PAPER.help: Choose the paper that matches this exam to process it again. Your edits are kept.
AMBIGUOUS_KEY_PAPER.helpProcessingOff: Document processing is switched off on this server, so the import cannot be processed again for one paper. Enter each answer yourself, or confirm to skip.

UNSUPPORTED_INTERACTION.title: This kind of question isn't supported
UNSUPPORTED_INTERACTION.help: Change it to a supported type if that truly fits, or exclude it with a reason. Relabelling alone isn't enough.

INVALID_QUESTION.title: The question isn't valid yet
INVALID_QUESTION.help: Check the question's content, options, answer and points.

INVALID_GROUP.title: The question group isn't valid
INVALID_GROUP.help: Each gap in the passage must belong to exactly one question. Check the group's questions or exclude the ones you don't use.

UNASSIGNED_SOURCE_TEXT.title_one: {{count}} passage wasn't placed in the exam
UNASSIGNED_SOURCE_TEXT.title_other: {{count}} passages weren't placed in the exam
UNASSIGNED_SOURCE_TEXT.help: Look at it in the document. If it's instructions or not needed, confirm to leave it out.

UNSUPPORTED_DOCUMENT_OBJECT.title_one: {{count}} object in the document couldn't be read
UNSUPPORTED_DOCUMENT_OBJECT.title_other: {{count}} objects in the document couldn't be read
UNSUPPORTED_DOCUMENT_OBJECT.help: For example a text box, drawing or embedded object. Check whether the exam needs that content.

MULTIPLE_PAPERS_IN_SOURCE.title: The document seems to contain several papers
MULTIPLE_PAPERS_IN_SOURCE.help: Check the recognised sections and exclude questions from another paper.

UNDERLINE_MARKS_MISSING.title: Pronunciation question has no underline
UNDERLINE_MARKS_MISSING.help: Pronunciation questions need the tested part underlined. Edit the options to add it, or confirm if the original has none.

IRREGULAR_OPTION_COUNT.title: A different number of options from the rest
IRREGULAR_OPTION_COUNT.help: Check for a missing or wrongly split option. If it matches the document, confirm.

SCORING_DEFAULTED.help: The document gives no points for these questions. Set each score if needed.

FORMATTING_SIMPLIFIED.title: Some formatting was simplified
FORMATTING_SIMPLIFIED.help: Fonts, colours and layout aren't kept; the content and marks such as underline are.

EMPTY_SECTION.title: This section has no questions
EMPTY_SECTION.help: An empty section isn't added to the draft.

NO_QUESTIONS.title: No questions are included
NO_QUESTIONS.help: Restore at least one excluded question, or check the source document.

NUMBERING_IRREGULAR.title: Question numbering isn't continuous
NUMBERING_IRREGULAR.help: Check for a missing question or numbering that restarts. If it matches the document, confirm.

OPTION_LABEL_REFERENCE.title: An option refers to another option
OPTION_LABEL_REFERENCE.help: This option refers to another option by its letter, such as “Both A and B”, which breaks if the options are shuffled. Reword the option, or confirm if you won't shuffle this question's options.

COLORED_TEXT_IN_CONTENT.title: Coloured text inside a question
COLORED_TEXT_IN_CONTENT.help: Coloured text may be a teacher's answer marking. Check it so the answer isn't shown to students.

UNKNOWN.title: Something to check ({{code}})
UNKNOWN.help: Look at the related content in the document.

objectReasons.INLINE_OBJECT_REQUIRES_REVIEW: This question has a picture or formula in the original that couldn't be brought in. Compare with the original and add it if needed.
objectReasons.LEGACY_NORMALIZATION_REQUIRES_REVIEW: The .doc file was converted; compare with the original to make sure nothing was lost.
objectReasons.TRACKED_CHANGE_REQUIRES_REVIEW: The document still has tracked changes. Check which version the exam uses.
objectReasons.HIDDEN_TEXT_REQUIRES_REVIEW: The document has hidden text. Check whether it's an answer or a teacher's note.
objectReasons.FIELD_REQUIRES_REVIEW: The document has automatic fields, such as page numbers. Check what they show.
objectReasons.TEXTBOX_ORDER_REQUIRES_REVIEW: The document has text boxes; the reading order may differ from the original.
objectReasons.ANCILLARY_CONTENT_REQUIRES_REVIEW: Headers, footers or notes contain text. Check whether the exam needs it.
objectReasons.OBJECT_REQUIRES_REVIEW: The document has an embedded object that couldn't be read. Compare with the original.
objectReasons.TABLE_GRID_REQUIRES_REVIEW: A table has merged cells or a complex layout; check the cell order.
objectReasons.COLUMN_ORDER_REQUIRES_REVIEW: The document uses columns; the reading order may differ from the original.
objectReasons.SOURCE_COLOR_REQUIRES_REVIEW: The document has coloured text; colour isn't kept. Check whether it marks answers.
objectReasons.RENDERER_LAYOUT_REQUIRES_REVIEW: The document's page layout isn't kept.
objectReasons.ALTERNATE_CONTENT_REQUIRES_RESOLUTION: The document has alternate content, such as a drawing with two versions. Check which one is used.
objectReasons.PDF_MARKS_UNAVAILABLE: A PDF does not keep underline, bold or text colour. If a question or its answer depends on those marks, mark them again during review.

review.staleBody: This import changed somewhere else, so changes here can no longer be saved. Reload to see the latest; unsaved changes here are discarded.
review.finishedBody: Processing has finished. Reload to see the latest review.
review.reloadBody: Unsaved changes on this page are discarded and the latest review is loaded.
review.committedBanner: A draft test has been created from this import. The review is now read-only.

readOnly.awaiting_sources: This import is waiting for files; the review is read-only.
readOnly.queued: Processing again. If you've edited the review, your version is kept and the new result is offered alongside it; if not, the new result replaces the current review.
readOnly.processing: Processing again. If you've edited the review, your version is kept and the new result is offered alongside it; if not, the new result replaces the current review.
readOnly.failed: The latest processing failed; the review is read-only.
readOnly.cancelled: This import was cancelled; the review is read-only.

review.reprocessed: A newer processing result is available. Your current review keeps your edits.
review.adoptBody: The review will be replaced by the new result. Every edit and confirmation you made on this draft will be discarded and can't be recovered.
review.adoptFailed: Couldn't use the new result. Please try again.
review.answerConflict: The sources disagree on the answer
review.answerMissing: The document has no answer for this
review.choosePaper: Choose the paper in the answer key
review.reprocessHint: If you've edited the review, your version is kept and the new result is offered alongside it; if not, the new result replaces the current review.
review.saveBeforeReprocess: Your changes aren't saved yet, so processing can't restart. Try saving again.
review.reprocessFailed: Couldn't process again. Please try again.
review.acceptedLimit: At most {{count}} answers of up to {{length}} characters each. Anything beyond that is not saved.
review.blankLimit: A question can have at most {{max}} blanks. Remove one before adding another.
review.excludeHint: An excluded question isn't added to the draft; the total points and question count change.
review.typeChangeBody: Changing from {{from}} to {{to}} drops some existing options or answers. The document evidence is kept.
review.pointsInvalid: Points must be a positive number with at most two decimals.
review.noBlanks: This question has no blanks. Edit the content to insert one.
review.sampleHint: The sample is only shown to teachers when grading; a short answer may not need one.
review.unsupportedHelp: The original content is kept. Choose a suitable type above, or exclude this question.
review.candidateUnusable: This value doesn't match an option; mark the answer yourself.
review.leaveFailed: Your changes couldn't be saved. Stay to retry, or leave and discard what isn't saved.
review.leaveStale: This import changed somewhere else, so the unsaved changes here cannot be saved. Leaving discards them.
review.notReady: This import has nothing to review yet.
review.notReadyHint: The review appears once processing finishes.
review.phoneGuidance: The review needs a screen at least 768px wide. Open it on a tablet or computer to edit.

summary.title: Summary before creating the draft
summary.body: The draft is a new test in your tests. It isn't published until you publish it.
summary.notReady: Resolve the remaining items before creating the draft.
summary.readyNote: Everything is resolved. You can create the draft.
summary.lost: No response from the server. Trying again won't create a duplicate.
summary.saveFailed: Your changes aren't saved, so the draft can't be created yet. Try saving again.
summary.stale: This import changed somewhere else. Reload the review to see the latest version before creating the draft.
summary.doneBody: The new test is in your tests as a draft. Open it in the builder to check it and publish when ready.

availability.off: Word and PDF import is not enabled on this server.
availability.offHint: An administrator needs to configure private storage for imported files. Meanwhile, you can still write tests directly.
availability.loadFailed: Could not check whether this server supports Word and PDF import.
availability.processingOff: Document processing is switched off on this server, so no new import can start. Imports that finished processing can still be reviewed and turned into tests.
availability.newOff: A new import cannot start right now.
availability.newOffHint: Document processing is switched off on this server. Imports that finished processing can still be reviewed and turned into tests from the import history.
availability.intakeOff: Document processing is switched off on this server, so files cannot be uploaded or processed again for this import. The import is kept as it is.
availability.queuedOff: Document processing is switched off on this server. The import will start when it is back on; you can cancel if you would rather not wait.
availability.reprocessOff: Document processing is switched off on this server, so the import cannot be processed again. The current review still works.
availability.startOverOff: Document processing is switched off on this server, so no new import can start.

retention.policy: Original files and the review are kept for {{afterCommit}} days after the test is created and {{afterCancel}} days after cancelling. An import with no changes for {{idle}} days is closed automatically.
retention.removed: The original files and the review were removed on {{date}} under the retention policy. The import's history is kept.
retention.idleWarning: An import with no changes for {{days}} days is closed and its files removed.
retention.reviewRemoved: This import's review was removed under the retention policy.
retention.sourceRemoved: The original file was removed under the retention policy, so its extracted text is no longer available.
